purpose: Determine whether the packaged ONNX Runtime QNN plugin can execute the fixed-shape QuickSRNetSmall 2x DCR graph on the Xiaomi 13 Ultra HTP without CPU fallback.

predictionBeforeRun.deviceDiscovery: A QNNExecutionProvider NPU device is expected because the target is Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, but this remains unobserved until the app enumerates it.
predictionBeforeRun.sessionCreation: The fixed FP32 DCR graph may still fail during QNN graph composition, device setup, or precision validation; such a failure is preserved and is not converted to CPU success.
predictionBeforeRun.performance: No performance claim is permitted from this profiling-enabled infrastructure probe.

qnnRuntime.versionDifferenceGate: Record the actual runtime result; do not silently describe 2.49.0 as 2.49.40.

forbidden: CPU success relabeled as QNN success

strictEvidenceGates: Required QNN plugin, HTP, System, V73 Stub, and V73 Skel libraries are packaged and hashed.
At least one QNNExecutionProvider device with hardwareType NPU is selected.
Provider configuration uses backend_type htp and disables CPU EP fallback.
Session creation and all 5 warmup plus 30 measured runs succeed.
ORT profile contains QNNExecutionProvider node events and zero non-target compute node events.
QNN profiling CSV is present, non-empty, and hash-linked.
Framework op trace is present and hash-linked.
Host golden correctness comparison passes before any correctness or NPU success claim is published.

claimPolicy.inAppPassMeaning: Runtime execution and structural sanity only.
